post.description: Phone + password. Driver must be **approved** (`application_status=approved`, `status=true`). Returns JWT for all protected `/delivery-man/*` routes and FCM **topic** for zone/vehicle pushes.

401.description: Invalid credentials, pending approval, or suspended account

value.msg: Credential do not match, please try again.
Your application is not approved yet

post.description: Figma 2-step registration. **Media:** `POST /storage/registration-init` `{ "role": "deliveryman" }` → `POST /upload` (category `profile` / `identity`) → pass `cloudflare_id` + R2 paths. Requires **`delivery_type` or `earning`**. Admin approval (`npm run approve-riders` or admin panel) before login.

example.msg: Registration successful! Please wait for admin approval.

post.description: Figma reset flow (phone only). Sends **4-digit OTP** via SMS; email OTP if driver has email. Dev/test OTP often **`1234`**. Resend cooldown in `data.resend_after_seconds`.

example.msg: OTP verified, you can set a new password

put.description: Create new password + confirm. Clears stored auth token (re-login required).
Profile → Change Password. Bearer from POST /delivery-man/login.

get.description: Wallet totals (PHP profile), period earnings (today / week / month / lifetime from `order_transactions`), and paginated **history** rows with full **order** + line **items**. Uses transactions when present; otherwise falls back to **delivered** orders. Search by order id.

parameters.name: summary_only
parameters.description: If true, returns only wallet + period summary

get.description: Figma home cards: **Today** / **This Week** / **This Month** order counts (by `accepted` time) and **Today's Earning** (delivery fee + tips from `order_transactions`). Bearer from login.
Returns delivery man profile fields (password/auth_token stripped). Same identity as JWT.

put.description: Edit driver name, email, optional password, profile image path, and vehicle. Legacy PHP path: **PUT /delivery-man/update-profile** (same handler).

get.description: Delivery man row without password. Prefer **GET /delivery-man/whoami** for app session; this endpoint also accepts legacy `dm_id` query when testing without JWT.

parameters.name: dm_id
parameters.description: Legacy/debug only — JWT `id` is used when Bearer is present

put.description: Flips `active` boolean (available for new order requests). Identity from Bearer JWT only.

get.description: Figma **My Orders** tab: completed/canceled/refunded/failed orders assigned to this driver. Paginated; optional search by order id or restaurant name.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: 1-based page number (legacy PHP name; same as `page`)

get.description: Home / active trip — assigned orders. Same card shape as **GET /orders/latest** (includes **restaurant_image_url**, **customer_image_url**, amounts, address snippet, lat/lng). Statuses: accepted, confirmed, processing, handover, picked_up, etc.

Order Request tab — unassigned jobs in the driver's **zone**. Each card includes **`restaurant_image_url`** (logo/cover) and **`customer_image_url`** (profile), plus names, COD/payment, delivery snippet, and customer **latitude/longitude** for map. Poll after FCM or on tab focus. Orders usually appear after vendor confirm (`confirmed` / `processing` / `handover`). Filters: schedule window, vehicle, digital pending payment.

Full order for **Order Request** tap-through or **active delivery** screen: restaurant + customer contact/location, line items, pricing breakdown, manual-dispatch summary, and flags **`can_accept`** / **`can_update_status`** / **`assigned_to_me`**. Allowed when the order is in the driver's pool (same rules as GET /orders/latest) or assigned to this driver. Response includes **`user_id`** (customer) and **`vendor_id`** (restaurant) for chat (`GET /delivery-man/message/details`). **Clients:** Driver app order detail + chat entry.

403.description: You cannot view this order (outside pool / zone / vehicle)

put.description: Assigns order to driver, increments `current_orders`, emits realtime status. Fails if already taken, outside zone, or max concurrent/cash limits.

404.description: Order not found or already assigned

put.description: Driver progress: `picked_up`, `handover`, `delivered`, `canceled` (requires `reason`). **On `delivered`:** runs PHP-style settlement (`order_transactions`, `delivery_man_wallets`, COD cash, `payment_status=paid`). **406** if settlement fails.

403.description: Not your order or cancel not allowed

406.description: Settlement failed (`create_order_transaction`) — order not marked delivered

token.description: Bearer JWT for all protected routes

topic.description: Firebase topic — subscribe for zone/vehicle order pushes

DeliveryManProfileData.description: Delivery man row without password or auth_token (GET whoami / profile)

identity_image.description: JSON array string of R2 paths

is_notification_on.description: When false, direct FCM device pushes are skipped. Toggle via PUT /delivery-man/notifications/toggle.

password.description: Optional — updates login password when provided

image.description: Stored media path from upload flow (category=profile)

vehicle_id.description: Set null to clear vehicle assignment

this_week_order_count.description: Orders accepted since start of week (Monday)

this_month_order_count.description: Orders accepted since start of calendar month

todays_earning.description: Sum of original_delivery_charge + dm_tips for today's transactions

DeliveryManMyOrderCard.description: Figma My Orders row — #id, title, item count, date/time, status pill, amount

DeliveryManOrderSummary.description: Order request / active card (GET /orders/latest and GET /orders/active)

delivery_charge.description: Driver delivery fee for this order

restaurant_image_url.description: Full URL (CLOUDFLARE_PUBLIC_URL + logo/cover) for pickup avatar

customer_image_url.description: Full URL for customer profile image (fallback def.png)

DeliveryManOrderDetail.description: GET /delivery-man/orders/{id} — Order Request / active delivery screen
